notes: final/ and start/ are separate apps. start/ is the tutorial's starting point: start/server/src/schema.js is empty, so the one operation in start/client (cart-item.tsx, Query.launch) has no server that declares the field. It is listed under unmatched_clients: linking it to final/server would join two apps that are never deployed together.
Fields marked @client (isLoggedIn, cartItems) are Apollo local state and are not call sites.

sources: manual reading of docker-compose.yml, router/router.yaml and client/src/apollo at the pinned commit: the client talks to the router, which plans each root field to the subgraph that declares it
notes: client/schema.graphql is the client's copy of the composed supergraph schema and client/src/apollo/localSchema.graphql declares local-only fields; neither is a server. A tool that reads either as a server scope finds every field in two scopes.
client/src/apollo/persisted-query-manifest.json and client/src/types/api.ts are build outputs that restate the operations; they are not call sites.
hop=federated_router: the client sends the operation to the router (router/router.yaml), which routes the root field to its subgraph.
